content:
Is there a formalization of the Desnanot-Jacobi identity (Dodgson condensation) in Mathlib? I couldn't find one. I have a proof using the adjugate, following Bressoud's Proofs and Confirmations:

https://github.com/slavanaprienko/lean-formalization

Would this be welcome as a Mathlib contribution? Any feedback on the proof is appreciated.

Kim Morrison said:

Yes, definitely, I actually need this. :-)

Great! Happy to clean it up for a PR. Any preferences on file location or naming conventions?
I also wanted to show how the DJ identity could be used in practice, so I've added a proof of the Cauchy determinant formula as well. Same repo: https://github.com/slavanaprienko/lean-formalization

PR is up. Filed it under Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Determinant/DesnanotJacobi.lean. Please let me know if there's a better location.

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/37716.
